subject: english
stem: To bike riders: The river path is closed after 6 p.m. Please use Green Street. Who needs this notice most?
options: people planning to ride bikes on the river path

optionRationales.reason: workers repairing every road：通知是給使用者。
people planning to ride bikes on the river path：To bike riders、path 與 alternate street 精確限定。
people swimming in the river：不是 path riders。
all drivers in town：範圍過廣且媒介不同。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「稱呼、先備資訊、媒介與讀者可採取的行動」可推出 people planning to ride bikes on the river path；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 people planning to ride bikes on the river path 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
